memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; walks 2 km daily without assistance; no aid needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (normal); no complaints of forgetfulness.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (below cut‑off).
medicines: 3 regular medicines; levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
mood: Reports feeling well; denies sadness or anxiety.
carers: Mother Anita Rao, mother.
goals: "I want to stay symptom-free and focus on my software job."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

Vitamin B12: 210 pg/mL (200-900).

carers: Mother Anita Rao, mother.
goals: "I want fewer hives so I can concentrate on coding."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; no urticaria lesions for 2 months; walks 2.5 km daily, feels energetic.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: No falls last year; gait good; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular medicines; levocetirizine 5 mg OD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD (cetirizine stopped due to daytime drowsiness).
mood: Reports improved mood, enjoys weekend hikes.
carers: Mother Anita Rao, mother.
goals: "I want to stay completely symptom‑free and advance my career."
